title: The Modifier
subtitle: Independent
description: The Modifier operated a Mod Parlor on Tatooine in the city of Mos Eisley. Cybernetically augmented himself, he's the man Boba Fett turned to when he tried to save Fennec Shand's life. The Modifier also paid Fett a visit to help repair Cobb Vanth after Vanth's run in with the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane.
